title: Memory Match
description: A playable card-matching game, pure vanilla JS with no dependencies or build step.

title: Library Fines
description: A SQLite schema plus a Python query layer, proven correct with a pytest suite against known seed data.

title: URL Shortener
description: A URL shortener with a strict routes/service/repository split, unit tests and HTTP integration tests, zero npm dependencies.

title: Wordle Clone
description: A 5-letter word-guessing game whose guess-evaluation logic (including the duplicate-letter edge case) is unit-tested separately from the DOM.

title: Expense Splitter
description: A Splitwise-style shared-expense tracker: SQL schema with weighted shares, integer-cents money math, and a greedy settlement algorithm.

title: Rate Limiter
description: A token-bucket rate limiter implemented as a pure algorithm, then wired into an HTTP server as middleware, with a fake-clock test suite and a live HTTP integration test.
